<CLT=cltMIND>We decided to hang out
in the AV room.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like we're the only ones here...
What should we do?
It's hard to decide what to watch
Play dominoes with the movie boxes
We should focus on reality, not movies

A degenerate male who's indecisive...
You're done for, Shuichi.
Aren't you ashamed of your life!?

Urghhh...!
Not bad for a degenerate!

It's definitely true that reality is more
important than movies...
However, degenerate males in real life...

Their existence doesn't make any sense!
God created them for some unknown reason!

Someday, I will surround myself with
only girls in real life!

<CLT=cltMIND>I wonder what's wrong?
Tenko looks deep in thought...
